title: 第1章 德国第二家族
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
“不过也好，至少在这个位面上我体会到了常人难以相信的权利和奢华。以及一种融入历史大潮，并且在改写和影响历史的感觉。”孙宇嘴角微微一笑。经过10年的皇室生活，现在的他已经适应了巴伐利亚摄者王长孙，未来的巴伐利亚王室皇储和家族首领——鲁普雷希特·玛利亚·柳特波德·斐迪南这个身份。
老实说，孙宇这次穿越还是很成功的，至少出身非常的高贵。无论是物质、政治地位、甚至是军事力量方面都可以甩开9成以上的穿越者前辈！巴伐利亚王室在德国算得上第二号家族，唯一比它高一些的就是只有德意志皇帝霍亨索伦家族。即使在整个欧洲，威特尔斯巴赫家族也是位居前列的大贵族。
至于他这具身体吗？在历史上也是赫赫有名！1战中德国陆军元帅，施利芬计划实施的时候，巴伐利亚军团的指挥者，第六集团军司令。麾下拥有20多万部队和近800门大炮。并且在西线成功的抵挡了法国人的攻势。从此一直担任德国陆军集团军级的指挥工作，而在1918年的弗兰德战役中，鲁普雷希特王子所掌控的兵力达到了巅峰，其手中拥有第2、第4、第6和第17，一共4个集团军！拥有83个师的作战单位！并成立了以他名字命名的集团军群！如此庞大的规模要是放到2战的话，那至少也是曼施坦因、朱可夫级别的吧！
作为一个机械专业毕业，兼业余军事和历史爱好者的穿越者，想一想自己“前身”历史上的作为，孙宇就感到压力巨大啊！从和平时期的小民到元帅，这个距离似乎用长征来形容都不为过啊！不过这哥们也有英雄迟暮的时候，他被称为德国所有王室成员中最为能打的将领之一，（注意，是之一，还有更NB的）但是随着1战德国的失败，这位德国陆军元帅永远也没有机会登上原本属于他的王位了。而在2战中，因为反对**的统治，还曾经进入过集中营。在2战结束后才放出来。前半段可以用春风得意来形容，而后半段则比较凄惨。
作为穿越者，似乎应该有逆天改命，笑傲世界的想法，但是穿越十年后，孙宇却没想那么多，作为一个对历史有一定了解，对军事史比较了解，再结合自己十年来的所见所闻，孙宇知道自己想要改变自己的命运有多困难！自己穿越的不是一只手残疾的威廉二世，也不是威廉二世的儿子，维特尔斯巴赫家族虽然NB，但是却缩在德国南部一隅之地。
德意志中央政府诚然一般不会干涉巴伐利亚内政，但是自己，好吧，即使是自己的爷爷，现任巴伐利亚头号扛把子！路易特波尔德摄政王也很难对德意志帝国内政外交构成重大影响。（各位BB党是不是对这个名字有点耳熟！不错，你猜对了，凯撒级的某艘战列舰就是以这个他的名字命名的！）
所以在穿越后第一年，孙宇给自己顶的目标是至少要在1战后成为一个足够富有的贵族，而最高目标自然是获得那顶本来应该落在自己头上的王冠！达则兼济天下，穷则独善其身！能当国王最好，当不了的话，也要好好渡过这一生！这就是孙宇的目标，非常现实！
不过虽然形势十分严峻，但是利好消息还是有的，不知道是自己穿越引发了时空改变或者是某些玄学的变化，历史在十九世纪八十年代发生了一些偏差，而这些偏差中最让主角欣慰的就是，威廉二世这个熊孩子没有在1888年登基！现在在皇位上的还是他老爸腓特烈三世！
因为医生误诊而导致病情耽误而发展到喉癌晚期的腓特烈三世并没有去世，在1887年动了手术之后，这位历史上做了30年太子，99天皇帝，没有临朝1天的悲催皇帝躲过了这次大劫。虽然现在身体依然不好，但是却稳稳的坐在皇帝的位置上！孙宇有的时候忍不住YY，如果老皇帝知道曾经的历史的话，会不会自己一些好处呢？比如说一个镶满钻石重达一吨的铂金奖章什么的.
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢帝国的崛起请大家
content_en:
"But it's okay, at least in this plane I experience rights and luxury that ordinary people can't believe. And a feeling of integrating into the historical trend, and rewriting and influencing history." Sun Yu smiled slightly. After 10 years of royal life, he has now adapted to the identity of Ruprecht Maria Liutpod Ferdinand, the eldest grandson of the Prince Photographer of Bavaria, the future crown prince and family leader of the Bavarian royal family.
To be honest, Sun Yu's time travel was quite successful, at least he was born into a very noble family. No matter in terms of material, political status, or even military strength, he can surpass more than 90% of the senior time travelers! The Bavarian royal family is considered the second-largest family in Germany. The only one higher than it is the Hohenzollern family of the German Emperor.即使在整个欧洲，威特尔斯巴赫家族也是位居前列的大贵族。
As for his body? It is also famous in history! In World War 1, the German Field Marshal was the commander of the Bavarian Army and the commander of the Sixth Army when the Schlieffen Plan was implemented. He has more than 200,000 troops and nearly 800 cannons under his command. And successfully resisted the French offensive on the Western Front. Since then, he has been commanding the German Army Group level. In the Battle of Flanders in 1918, Prince Ruprecht's military strength reached its peak. He had the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 17th armies in his hands, a total of 4 armies! Has 83 divisions of combat units! And established an army group named after him! If such a huge scale were put into the second battle, it would be at least the level of Manstein and Zhukov!
As a time-traveler who graduated with a major in mechanics and is an amateur military and history enthusiast, Sun Yu feels tremendous pressure when thinking about his "predecessor"'s actions in history! From a commoner in peacetime to a marshal, this distance seems to be described as the Long March! However, this guy also has his moments of heroism. He is known as one of the most capable generals among all members of the German royal family (note, he is one of them, and there are even more NB ones). However, with the defeat of Germany in World War 1, the German field marshal will never have the opportunity to ascend the throne that originally belonged to him. During World War II, he even entered a concentration camp because he opposed the Japanese rule. It was released after the second battle. The first half can be described as triumphant, while the second half is more miserable.
As a time traveler, it seems that you should have the idea of ​​​​defying the will of nature and changing your destiny to be proud of the world. However, after traveling for ten years, Sun Yu did not think so much. As a person who has a certain understanding of history and a relatively good understanding of military history, combined with what he has seen and heard in the past ten years, Sun Yu knows how difficult it is for him to change his own destiny! The person he traveled through was not William II with a disabled hand, nor was he his son. Although the Wittelsbach family was NB, they were huddled in a corner of southern Germany.
It is true that the German central government generally does not interfere in Bavaria's internal affairs, but he, well, even his grandfather is the current number one in Bavaria! It was also difficult for Prince Regent Luitpold to have a major influence on the domestic and foreign affairs of the German Empire. (Every BB party, does this name sound familiar to you? Yes, you guessed it right, a certain Caesar-class battleship is named after him!)
Therefore, in the first year after time travel, Sun Yu's goal for himself was to become a rich enough noble at least after the first battle, and the highest goal was naturally to obtain the crown that should have fallen on his head! If you are prosperous, you can help the world; if you are poor, you can help yourself! It's best to be a king. If you can't be a king, you should still spend this life well! This is Sun Yu's goal, very realistic!
However, although the situation is very serious, there is still good news. I don’t know whether my time travel has caused changes in time and space or some metaphysical changes.History had some deviations in the 1880s, and the most gratifying of these deviations for the protagonist is that Wilhelm II, a naughty boy, did not ascend the throne in 1888! His father, Frederick III, is still on the throne now!
Frederick III, who developed late-stage throat cancer due to a misdiagnosis by a doctor, did not die. After surgery in 1887, this tragic emperor who had been a prince for 30 years and emperor for 99 days, without even one day in court, escaped this catastrophe. Although he is still in poor health, he is firmly sitting in the emperor's position! Sometimes Sun Yu couldn't help but wonder. If the old emperor knew the past history, would it benefit him? For example, a platinum medal studded with diamonds and weighing one ton.
